NEWS EVENTS


September 4, 2026


*Acquisition Expands the Agilysys Loyalty and Fuel/Retail Ecosystem Capabilities Across the Casino Gaming Vertical*


ALPHARETTA, GA (September 4, 2026) –[Agilysys, Inc.](https://www.agilysys.com/en/) (Nasdaq: AGYS), a global hospitality-focused technology provider, today announced the acquisition of Gaming Hospitality Solutions (GHS), a longtime technology partner and specialist in casino loyalty, offer management and fuel/retail integration. The acquisition deepens the Agilysys solution set for the casino gaming vertical for tribal gaming operators.


Through its LEEP platform, GHS brings more than 30 years of expertise in loyalty automation and offer management. LEEP powers real-time offer orchestration, tier benefits and dynamic promotions that enable personalized guest experiences across casino resorts, retail and fuel operations, including loyalty programs that extend to gas stations and travel plazas, a common feature at tribal casino properties. The GHS portfolio also includes LEEP for Cruise and Fleet Cards, which will continue serving their respective markets with continuity and support.


The GHS solutions have now been brought into the Agilysys ecosystem, strengthening the Agilysys InfoGenesis Point-of-Sale (POS) roadmap and providing casino customers a more unified guest experience across gaming floors, resorts, spas, golf and fuel/retail operations.


> “This acquisition validates the strength of our solutions and the relationships we have built with our customers,” said Gary Kortz, Chairman and CEO of Gaming Hospitality Solutions. “We built GHS around the belief that loyalty automation and offer management drive real business results for casinos. Now, with the Agilysys development strength behind us, we can accelerate innovation and deliver even more powerful capabilities to our customers.”


“For casino customers, the expanded Agilysys portfolio offers the most comprehensive suite of solutions for gaming enterprises,” said Rohith Kori, Senior Vice President of Corporate and Product Strategy at Agilysys. “We can support every facet of casino and tribal operations, including casinos, hotels, spas, golf courses, gas stations and convenience stores, while extending loyalty capabilities across the full guest journey.”


The GHS team will remain in place, continuing operations as part of the Agilysys solution suite for gaming and cruise industry customers. GHS customers can expect continuity in day-to-day support and service as the companies work together to advance and expand the joint solution roadmap.


###


**About Agilysys, Inc.**
Agilysys delivers state-of-the-art software and services built exclusively for hospitality, helping organizations go beyond traditional property management (PMS), point-of-sale (POS), and food and beverage inventory and procurement systems. Its best-in-class solutions operate independently or as a unified ecosystem that connects data and workflows across an operation, property or enterprise. Powered by intelligent guest profiles, data-driven capabilities, and embedded artificial intelligence (AI), Agilysys is architected on a unified data model with a single set of APIs that create shared operational memory across all systems, enabling guest-specific insights to be acted on in real time at any touchpoint. Agilysys delivers advantage through pace and integration, transforming hospitality technology from a system of record into a system of action that accelerates innovation and the rapid delivery of new capabilities. Agilysys serves a 100% hospitality customer base, including hotels and resorts, casinos, cruise lines, corporate and campus dining, healthcare, senior living, and entertainment venues worldwide. Agilysys operates across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and India with headquarters located in Alpharetta, GA. For more information visit[Agilysys.com](https://www.agilysys.com/) .


**About Gaming Hospitality Solutions**
Since 1993, Gaming Hospitality Solutions has quietly set the gold standard in loyalty, providing expert software for offer management, marketing automation, and loyalty enablement to the casino and hospitality industries. The LEEP suite delivers sophisticated solutions for loyalty and retail operations, with LEEP for Casino powering offer management, tier benefits, and real-time personalization, LEEP for C-Stores extending loyalty benefits to fuel and retail operations with integrated Fleet Cards for internal and external fleet management, and LEEP for Cruise serving the cruise industry. For more information, visit[www.ghsloyalty.com](http://www.ghsloyalty.com/) .
